verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a first-party SDK page covering installation, authentication and async calls, so official SDK support exists. Missing for 10: supported languages and multiple SDKs, SDK reference detail (typed models, method coverage), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
